description: Move up to 50 threads to the inbox, the archive or the trash in one call, each exactly as move_thread would. Answers one result per thread (done, unchanged, notFound, failed for an error on our side that is safe to ask again, folderMissing with the mailbox that has no folder of that kind, or moveUnsupported with the mailbox whose mail server can't move messages), so one thread failing never stops the rest, and a batchId. undo_thread_moves takes that batchId and the thread ids to put back what this call moved. A key an owner limited to some mailboxes and agent inboxes changes only the thread's copies in those.

folder.description: Where the thread goes. The mail you sent in it goes back to Sent rather than the inbox, and drafts stay where they are.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

threadIds.description: The threads, by id: at least 1 and at most 50. A repeated id counts once.

name: move_threads
title: Move many threads
